description: Validates skill routing accuracy: domain matching, disambiguation between overlapping skills, no-skill rejection.

dimensions.name: correct_routing
dimensions.description: Routes to the most specific skill covering the task

dimensions.name: disambiguation
dimensions.description: Correctly disambiguates between similar skills using trigger keyword comparison

dimensions.name: no_skill_case
dimensions.description: Correctly routes to 'no skill' when zero skills match

dimensions.name: token_efficiency
dimensions.description: Uses system prompt catalog, does not load secondary references for simple routing
